policy.eligibility: only existing unlocked ultimate; request while cooldown/CP blocked shows reason; do not consume CP until legal cast start
policy.persistence: one pending intent per actor, replace only on explicit user selection, cancel manually/death/battle end; no automatic expiry or silent substitution
policy.target: AI resolves legal target at commit, no alternate ultimate

skills.request: explicit skill ID; no auto selection of another ultimate; AI chooses legal target only
